title: Rectangular geometry for conditional κ = 1.2260937e-5 > 2^-17
body:
A compatible rectangular basis and the contiguous A5 block improve the bit interface at dimensions **(28,27,57)**. Composing it with the retained #23 semantic/bulk interfaces gives

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{12260937}{10^{12}}=1.2260937\times10^{-5}>2^{-17}.$$

This is about **2.4127% above #27's 1.19720853e-5 witness** in asymptotic exponent saving. It is not a practical runtime comparison.

### Geometric change

The prescribed basis construction extends from (25,23,57) to (28,27,57), with an explicit compatible system of partial permutations and two A5 incidence trees. The written A1 argument tracks the actual coefficient groups and nonzero pivot factors. The A3 proof cancels a rank-56 perturbation and establishes the full null-corner rank using free second rows and penultimate inverse columns in disjoint prescription intervals. Generic nonproportionality supplies the necessary nonzero diagonal entries.

The resulting conservative profiles are:

- A1: `28, 1, 28, 28, 42922`;
- A3: `113 singletons; 55, 644, 41468`;
- A5: `29 singletons; 25, 648`;
- translated auxiliary: `27, 43038`.

The A5 block is the dimension-general form of our #25 cancellation argument. No separated pivots are gathered or reversed. The remaining singleton pivots are still charged.

The selected scalar producers have been reconstructed and their complete histograms checked. The new bit parameters are `m=43092`, `W=13904995529880`, `N=280378098000`, `L=162580083120`, with exact rank sum `599193831777559200 = Wm−2N+2L`. The certified bit saving is **12261239/10^12**.

### Recomputed semantic assembly

The PR21 complex circuit and PR23 semantic precision bound **C1=1** remain unchanged. The changed bit dimensions require a new product row stock: bit halving depth **553**, bit wire exponent **44**, complex depth **544**, and complex wire exponent **41**. The combined coefficient is **46636** and the sufficient stock is **p^96000**, with suffix coefficient **384000**. The older p^89000 allowance is not reused.

The complex saving stays 18e-6 with beta=1/4, so its leaf saving 13.5e-6 exceeds the new bit saving. All **47 strict constraints and seven final margins** pass exact arithmetic; the final absorption gap is greater than **9e-13**. All changed eventual cutoffs are recomputed.

### Validation and review base

- Seven new focused regression tests pass, covering exact A1/A5 corners, prescription/tree compatibility, complete rank accounting, changed row stock and assembly failure modes.
- Portable h27/h28 producers were freshly rebuilt: scalar maps, both carrier matchings, positive labels, complete histograms and deterministic binary hashes all match. The h57 fresh full-run receipt is pinned and checked against the new inputs.
- An independent parallel review reconstructed the complete histogram and rank mass, replayed producer checks, verified all provenance hashes, and reproduced the exact certificate. Two separate mathematical audits examined the general A1/A3/A5 arguments.
- The five-page manuscript compiled without warnings. The focused source patch forward-applied against pinned #25 and reconstructed all 20 source files exactly.
- Current evidence and scope are recorded in `research/rectangular-semantic/validation.json`.

**Full repository rerun: PASS.** `make verify` completed successfully on commit `3eafe5a35b572fe38e7d64a55ce5cac1d8838bee`: **187 tests** (67.092 seconds for the test suite), **18 historical upstream patch checks**, both focused source-patch checks, fresh h27/h28 and inherited h25/h23/h57 producer reconstruction, and the complex reconstruction. The full log SHA256 is `51a53f0527864262086b20c883c9e9bbd0849c1ddcd5def8db3bd750d896ff03`. The validation receipt records scope and completion time. Ready for external review; the inherited mathematical assumptions remain.

The branch starts at our ready #25 commit `003f366cfa99e19fbeacd9300a219f2d44c8cff0`, whose full run passed 180 tests, 18 historical patch checks and fresh predecessor producer reconstruction. The main-branch diff includes its pending dependencies; commit `3eafe5a` isolates the rectangular extension, followed by a validation-receipt-only commit. The focused source patch targets pinned #25, not the original OpenAI manuscript.

This remains conditional on the inherited general basis, analytic, routing, bulk, fixed-tape and exact-recovery arguments. Exact arithmetic, finite controls and independent agent review are not formal verification or completed external expert review. A finite dimension search is not a proof of global optimality.
